gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI Press Note on Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP FY2025-26 and Quarterly Estimates of GDP for Q4 (Jan–Mar) FY2025-26, released June 5, 2026. Q4 real GDP growth 7.8% YoY (nominal 9.1%), broadly flat vs Q3 FY26 (7.8%, later revised toward ~8%) — momentum moderating slightly rather than accelerating.

cpi.source: MoSPI Consumer Price Index Press Release for May 2026 (provisional, base year 2024), released June 12, 2026. All-India CPI YoY inflation 3.93%; CFPI (food) YoY 4.78%.

gsec10y.source: India 10Y G-Sec benchmark yield trackers (Trading Economics / Investing.com, corroborating RBI/CCIL market data): yield fell to ~6.74% on July 9, 2026, down roughly 37 bps over the preceding six weeks on FII inflows, softer crude, and easing monsoon-inflation risk.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC held repo rate at 5.25% on June 5, 2026 — third consecutive hold, unanimous, neutral stance maintained. FY27 GDP growth forecast cut to 6.6% (from 6.9%) and inflation forecast raised to 5.1% (from 4.6%) on West Asia conflict, energy prices and monsoon uncertainty. Next MPC meeting scheduled Aug 3–5, 2026.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution, June 5, 2026 (via Deccan Herald / Forbes India MPC coverage).

gov_capex.note: 63 CPSEs hit 25% of their cumulative FY27 capex target in Q1 (Apr–Jun 2026); capex rose 26% YoY to ₹2.10 lakh crore. Railway Board reached 33% and NHAI 24% of their annual FY27 targets — capex-led growth push continues into FY27 beyond the Feb 1 Budget announcement.
gov_capex.source: Department of Public Enterprises (Ministry of Finance) data, reported via Business Standard, July 6–7, 2026.

china_plus_one.note: China+1 manufacturing reorientation to India remains a structural (not temporary) shift per BusinessToday analysis; PLI scheme has approved 836 applications with ₹2.16 lakh crore committed investment; March 2026 Press Note 3 amendment (60-day fast-track approval for Chinese minority stakes in electronics, capital goods, solar) remains in effect and continues to support the thesis.
china_plus_one.source: BusinessToday — 'Can China+1 help India create millions of jobs and boost manufacturing?' (June 2, 2026); DPIIT/Commerce Ministry FDI policy framework.

rural_recovery.note: Kharif sowing at 350.85 lakh hectares as of July 5, 2026 — down 20.8% YoY (rice -13.1%, soybean -31.4 lakh ha, cotton -23%) due to delayed monsoon. All-India rainfall deficit narrowed to 17% (from ~40% at end-June) as monsoon picks up in July per Agriculture Minister; farmers advised to switch to short-duration crops under 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan'.
rural_recovery.source: Union Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare sowing data and IMD rainfall tracking, as reported July 7–8, 2026 (Business Standard).

put_call_ratio.source: NSE Nifty option chain aggregate for the 14-Jul-2026 expiry (Total Put OI 28.33L contracts vs Total Call OI 22.28L contracts) via NiftyTrader.in.
